description: This file is a shell script used for self-healing, diagnostics, and recovery operations on a device. It includes functions for monitoring system health, managing processes, rebooting the device, and handling configuration related to network interfaces, security, and maintenance windows.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Extracts the specified field from a string based on delimiter

methods.name: change
methods.description: Calculates the difference in CPU statistics between start and end states

methods.name: getVendorName
methods.description: Retrieves the device vendor name via dmcli or fallback methods

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns current date and time in YYYY:MM:DD:HH:MM:SS format

methods.name: getDateTime
methods.description: Returns current date and time with microseconds

methods.name: getCMMac
methods.description: Retrieves the Cable Modem MAC address through system or SNMP commands

methods.name: restart_adv_security
methods.description: Restarts the advanced security process based on device type and security state

methods.name: checkConditionsbeforeAction
methods.description: Checks network registration and traffic conditions before taking corrective action

methods.name: resetRouter
methods.description: Performs reset procedures, reinitializing network and system configurations

methods.name: rebootNeeded
methods.description: Determines if reboot is required based on system health, diagnostics, and counts

methods.name: checkCaptivePortal
methods.description: Checks and possibly enables captive portal based on network and configuration status

methods.name: resetNeeded
methods.description: Handles process restart or reset operations, including saving logs and configuration

methods.name: storeInformation
methods.description: Gathers system health data, logs memory usage, CPU load, connected devices, and MoCA stats

methods.name: logNetworkInfo
methods.description: Collects and logs detailed network interface and routing information

methods.name: CheckRebootCretiriaForAtomHang
methods.description: Checks if the system should reboot due to atom hang conditions (specific to certain device modes)

methods.name: SetRebootConfigForAtomHang
methods.description: Configures reboot parameters when an atom hang is detected

methods.name: setRebootreason
methods.description: Sets the reboot reason and counter in system configuration
